fullPassage: We not only absorb our moral codes and definitions of right and wrong from the group; the group also transmits cues about cooperation and defection and what it means to act in a trustworthy manner. People are more likely to suppress their self-interest in favor of the group interest if they feel that others are doing so as well, and they’re less likely to do so if they feel that others are taking advantage of them. The psychological mechanism for this is unclear, but certainly it is related to our innate sense of fairness. We generally don’t mind sacrificing for the group, as long as we’re all sacrificing equally. But if we feel like we’re being taken advantage of by others who are defecting, we’re more likely to defect as well.

(A) We generally don’t mind sacrificing for the group, as long as we’re all sacrificing equally. But if we feel like we’re being taken advantage of by others who are defecting, we’re more likely to defect as well.

(B) People are more likely to suppress their self-interest in favor of the group interest if they feel that others are doing so as well, and they’re less likely to do so if they feel that others are taking advantage of them.

(C) The psychological mechanism for this is unclear, but certainly it is related to our innate sense of fairness.

① (A)-(C)-(B)
→ 도입문에서 협력/이탈의 단서를 언급한 직후 바로 희생 이야기(A)가 오면 자기이익 억제(B)의 맥락이 빠짐. 부적절

→ '자유'에 대한 언급이 본문에 없으며 충성(loyalty)도 본문의 표현과 다름. 부적절

빈칸 뒤 'doing so as well'에서 so가 가리키는 행위와, 'less likely to do so if ~ taking advantage'의 대비 구조. 뒤이어 '공평한 희생'과 '이탈' 이야기가 이어지므로 자기이익 억제가 정확히 부합

questions.passage: We not only absorb our moral codes and definitions of right and wrong from the group; the group also transmits cues about cooperation and defection and what it means to act in a trustworthy manner. People are more likely to suppress their self-interest __________, and they’re less likely to do so if they feel that others are taking advantage of them. The psychological mechanism for this is unclear, but certainly it is related to our innate sense of fairness. We generally don’t mind sacrificing for the group, as long as we’re all sacrificing equally. But if we feel like we’re being taken advantage of by others who are defecting, we’re more likely to defect as well.
